reason: E1 demonstrates that coherent, ordered nanoprecipitates (<15 nm) in a CoFeNiTaAl HEA significantly improve strength with only a marginal increase in coercivity, supporting the general concept. However, E1 does not provide evidence for the specific (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy system, its ability to form such precipitates via heat treatment, or the insensitivity of its caloric transition to precipitates; these premises are unsupported.
premises: Coherent nanoprecipitates (<15 nm) can strengthen an alloy without significantly degrading a functional property (magnetic/caloric).
The strengthening mechanism involves dislocation pinning and microband refinement by coherent nanoprecipitates.
The specific HEA (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 can form such coherent nanoprecipitates via heat treatment.
The caloric phase transition in this alloy is insensitive to the presence of a moderate volume fraction of coherent nanoprecipitates.
